name: Windows Update Leftovers
description: Installer payloads Windows Update downloaded. They sit inside the Windows directory, which WinKnife reports on and never removes anything from — so this pack is informational and is off by default.

rules.reason: Windows Update keeps the installers it downloaded here. This is inside the Windows directory, which WinKnife never removes anything from, so it is only ever reported: use Windows' own Disk Cleanup and tick "Windows Update Cleanup" if you want the space back.
